post.summary:
Cancels a queued item at once (200), or asks the running item's Worker to cancel it at its
next heartbeat (202). A finished item is a 409 showing the item as it is.
Queues a sweep, or returns the one already queued.

Queues one deletion per storage config the selected orphans name; orphans of configs that no
longer exist, or of none, share one unscoped deletion.

parameters.name: sweepId
parameters.description: The sweep whose orphans to delete.

refreshToken.description: The refresh token, for a client that keeps it itself.

TokenResponse.description: The access token, with the refresh token only when it is not set as a cookie.
